semantics: Levels clips/stretches intensity; it does not directly create binary masks.
Ruler defaults to image pixels; physical spacing must be explicitly supplied, never inferred.
Applied Wand reads the enhanced picture in source-dtype intensity units; post-detection morphology and splitting remain automatic-detector operations.
Original source pixels, measurements and existing masks are preserved until an explicit mask edit.
